Voting extended for special categories in the Best Places To Work Awards

Now that Gamescom is firmly behind us, the GamesIndustry.biz team is busy judging the entries for this year's Best Places To Work Awards. Entries have closed for our headline awards, which are judged based on anonymous employee feedback - but we have extended the deadline for nominations for our Special Awards, which reward excellence in specific fields.
